query: SELECT r.id AS "run_id!", count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'queued') AS "queued_tasks!", count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'claimed') AS "running_tasks!", min(t.claimed_at) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'claimed') AS oldest_claim_at, COALESCE( array_agg(DISTINCT t.kind) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'claimed'), ARRAY[]::text[] ) AS "kinds!", count(DISTINCT t.worker_id) FILTER (WHERE t.state = 'claimed') AS "workers!" FROM scan_runs r LEFT JOIN scan_tasks t ON t.run_id = r.id WHERE r.state IN ('queued','running') GROUP BY r.id
